observations: A yellow disc in the upper left sprouts wavy radiating lines across the canvas; it carries a small teal rectangular shape and a downturned line mouth.
A triangular wedge dominates the center, filled with layered orange, red, and olive scribble loops over a yellow-gold base, with dark outlines fraying at the edges.
A round yellow form below the wedge bears large red-framed rectangular eye shapes and a wide mouth showing a row of small rectangular teeth, rendered in dense overlapping black lines.
reading: Two face forms share the canvas — one small and downturned in the upper corner, one large and tooth-baring below — with a wedge shape pressed between them. Yellow dominates, but red and olive push through the scribbled surface. The gritted teeth and the downturned disc read as opposing moods held in the same warm, restless field of line.
